comparison.objective: Raise a loaded instrument stand by two indexed holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Load transfer while releasing and reseating two pull pins under asymmetric assistance.
comparison.success_condition: Stand finishes level and untouched for one second within jolt, downward-speed, and 60 N wrist-force limits.
comparison.reason: Both adjust and verify equipment, but this tests bimanual load-bearing indexed-height transfer with pull pins; the candidate tests tool-mediated continuous collar tuning and repeated axial stopping response.
